name: Rebecca's Raunchy Retreat
source:
Not so long ago timid and shy, now confident [url=/c111127]Rebecca[/url] gets the challenging and exciting task of setting up and running her own love hotel. With some pointers from [url=/c111126]Clara[/url], Bex sets out to turn her new business into a proper house of sexual indulgence full of sexy girls and taboo pleasure!

Help Bex run her own brothel, hire girls, entertain clients, keep Clara happy, and deal with the drama and pitfalls of a whorehouse full of naughty girls! 

It's up to you whether this new venture is a success and what exactly awaits the girls working there!

Rebecca's continues where [url=/v32608]Clara's Love Hotel[/url] left off with Bex getting to manage her own brothel. We'll add a small plot recap in the future, but you might want to play Clara's Love Hotel before for the best experience. A bit of backstory for one of the girls is available in [url=/v40201]Sexploitation[/url].

This is just a start for Rebecca's, you will be able to hire more girls and have more options on how the business and the story develop! There's definitely more to come and we are excited to have more updates for you in the future!

[From Itch.io]
translation:
曾经胆怯害羞的[url=/c111127]Rebecca[/url]如今已变得自信，她接下了一个充满挑战又令人兴奋的任务：建立并经营自己的爱情旅馆。在[url=/c111126]Clara[/url]的指点下，Bex准备把新事业打造成真正的纵欲之所，里面满是性感女孩与禁忌的欢愉！

帮助Bex经营自己的妓院、雇用女孩、招待客人、哄Clara开心，并处理这家满是调皮女孩的妓院里接连不断的麻烦与风波！

这项新事业能否成功、在这里工作的女孩们将迎来什么，全由你决定！

《Rebecca's》接续[url=/v32608]《Clara的爱情旅馆》[/url]的剧情，讲述Bex开始经营自己的妓院。之后会补上一段简短的剧情回顾；不过，想获得最佳体验，最好先玩《Clara的爱情旅馆》。[url=/v40201]Sexploitation[/url]中还介绍了一位女孩的背景故事。

《Rebecca's》目前才刚刚起步。你将能雇用更多女孩，也能有更多选择来决定事业与剧情的发展！未来还会推出更多内容，我们期待继续为你带来更新！
